cohort: The study included 52 pregnant patients, divided into 26 with severe preeclampsia and 26 normotensive controls.
finding: There was a significant relationship between adiponectin serum levels and the incidence of severe preeclampsia and normotency.
mod_finding: There was no relationship between delivery method and the incidence of severe preeclampsia or normotency concerning adiponectin levels.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, when samples were taken from patients with severe preeclampsia and normotensive controls.
